Explore the booth

Three walls. One clear story.

Our KME booth is designed to introduce who we are, the people behind our homestay community, and the expanding range of travel and educational experiences we can build with partners.

New & expanded services

Build a Korea program around your group.

Use the filters to explore the experiences we can combine into customized itineraries for schools, groups, institutions and travel partners.

Homestay Programs

Stay with a welcoming local host family and experience everyday Korean life beyond the tourist route.

Local connection

Home Visits

Short-format local encounters that bring guests into a Korean home for conversation, food and cultural exchange.

Local connection

Cultural & Historical Tours

Palaces, hanok neighborhoods, museums, markets and heritage sites with context that brings Korea’s past to life.

Culture

Hands-on Activities

K-pop dance, Korean cooking, Minhwa painting, taekwondo and other participatory cultural workshops.

Hands-on

Youth Exchange

Cross-cultural programs designed around meaningful interaction, shared activities and peer-to-peer learning.

Education

Study Abroad

Flexible educational experiences that connect academic goals with cultural immersion and local life in Korea.

Education

STEM Programs

Innovation, science and technology experiences that connect learning with Korea’s dynamic industries and institutions.

STEM

Nature Tours

Outdoor and ecology-focused experiences that reveal another side of Korea through landscapes, trails and local environments.

Nature
For buyers & partners

More than a tour supplier.

Homestay Korea brings together local homes, cultural experiences and educational programs so partners can create more personal, differentiated Korea itineraries. Meet us at KME to discuss the audience, learning goals, group size and experience mix that fits your program.
